result.keyword: How to register a Wyoming LLC, open Mercury bank, and apply for Apple and Google organization developer accounts from China without an SSN?
result.markdown:
Setting up a U.S. corporate structure (Wyoming LLC), opening a digital business bank account (Mercury), and applying for official Apple and Google organization developer accounts from China **without a U.S. Social Security Number (SSN)** is a well-established and entirely legal roadmap for international founders. Because you reside in China and do not have an SSN, you will use your **People's Republic of China (PRC) Passport** for identification.

The complete, sequential blueprint to execute this from start to finish is outlined below.

---

### Step 1: Form Your Wyoming LLC
You do not need to be a U.S. citizen, resident, or have an SSN to form a Wyoming LLC.[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/wyoming-llc-for-non-residents#:~:text=HynoConnectSIM.%20Client%20Portal.%20Quick%20Answer.%20Non-US%20residents,%E2%80%94%20no%20SSN%2C%20no%20US%20visit%20required.) 

1. **Appoint a Wyoming Registered Agent:** Wyoming law requires a registered agent with a physical street address in the state to accept legal mail.[corpbolt.com](https://corpbolt.com/help/company-formation/wyoming-llc-for-non-residents/#:~:text=*%20Appoint%20a%20registered%20agent.%20Wyoming%20requires,ownership%2C%20management%2C%20and%20how%20the%20company%20runs%3B) You can hire a reputable formation service (e.g., Northwest Registered Agent, Firstbase, or HynoGo) which will provide this agent and a physical mailing address.[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/wyoming-llc-for-non-residents#:~:text=HynoGo%20delivers%20Articles%20of%20Organization%2C%20EIN%2C%20and,Anonymous%20Ownership.%20*%200%25%20State%20Income%20Tax.)
2. **File Articles of Organization:** Submit the Articles of Organization to the Wyoming Secretary of State.[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/wyoming-llc-for-non-residents#:~:text=Wyoming%20law%20requires%20a%20physical%20registered%20agent,like%20Mercury%20and%20payment%20processors%20like%20Stripe.) The standard state filing fee is **$100**.[corpbolt.com](https://corpbolt.com/help/company-formation/wyoming-llc-for-non-residents/#:~:text=*%20File%20the%20Articles%20of%20Organization.%20This,Number%20is%20your%20company's%20federal%20tax%20ID.) This can be completed online within 24 hours.[wyomingexperts.com](https://wyomingexperts.com/blog/how-to-get-llc-without-ssn#:~:text=No%20travel%2C%20no%20US%20address%2C%20no%20SSN.,guaranteed%20filing.%20Free%20PDF%20%C2%B7%202%20pages.)
3. **Draft an Operating Agreement:** Create an internal company document detailing that you are the 100% owner/manager of the LLC.[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/wyoming-llc-for-non-residents#:~:text=Submit%20the%20required%20formation%20documents%20and%20the,Employer%20Identification%20Number%20directly%20from%20the%20IRS.) Banks like Mercury and payment processors like Stripe will require this.[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/wyoming-llc-for-non-residents#:~:text=Submit%20the%20required%20formation%20documents%20and%20the,Employer%20Identification%20Number%20directly%20from%20the%20IRS.)

---

### Step 2: Obtain an EIN (Employer Identification Number) Without an SSN
Because you do not have an SSN, you **cannot** use the IRS online portal (which strictly requires an SSN/ITIN for the responsible party). Instead, you must apply via mail or fax.

1. **Fill out Form SS-4** (Application for Employer Identification Number).[www.ein.so](https://www.ein.so/blog/ein-for-mobile-app-developers/#:~:text=Apple's%20verification%20for%20organizations%20is%20the%20strictest,apply%20for%20the%20EIN%20on%20Form%20SS-4.)
   * On **Line 7b** (where an SSN/ITIN is normally requested), write **"Foreign"** or **"N/A"**.[www.ein.so](https://www.ein.so/blog/ein-for-mobile-app-developers/#:~:text=Apple%20supports%20the%20transition%2C%20but%20it%20takes,A%20US%20individual%20can%20use%20an%20SSN.)
2. **Submit via Fax:** Fax the completed and signed Form SS-4 to the IRS international fax line (**+1-855-215-1627**).[www.ein.so](https://www.ein.so/blog/ein-for-mobile-app-developers/#:~:text=Apple%20supports%20the%20transition%2C%20but%20it%20takes,A%20US%20individual%20can%20use%20an%20SSN.) *(Note: Many international founders use a specialized EIN filing agency or their registered agent service to handle this securely to avoid international long-distance friction).*
3. **Receive your CP 575 / Letter 147C:** The IRS will process the fax and return an official EIN confirmation letter (typically within 1 to 3 weeks).

---

### Step 3: Open a Mercury Bank Account
Mercury is a popular fintech banking partner that explicitly supports remote international founders who own U.S. LLCs.[support.mercury.com](https://support.mercury.com/hc/en-us/articles/28770467511060-Eligibility-and-requirements-for-opening-a-Mercury-account#:~:text=Mercury%20supports%20most%20U.S.-registered%20companies%2C%20including%20those,in%20adult%20entertainment%2C%20cannabis%2C%20or%20internet%20gambling.)

1. **Prepare Your Documents:**
   * Certificate of Formation / Articles of Organization (Wyoming)[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/services/mercury-business#:~:text=What%20You%20Provide%20*%201.%20State-certified%20US,phone%20line%20%28HynoConnect%29%20for%202FA%20security%20verification.)
   * IRS EIN Confirmation Letter (CP 575 or 147C)[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/services/mercury-business#:~:text=What%20You%20Provide%20*%201.%20State-certified%20US,phone%20line%20%28HynoConnect%29%20for%202FA%20security%20verification.)
   * LLC Operating Agreement
   * Your valid **PRC Passport**[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/services/mercury-business#:~:text=What%20You%20Provide%20*%201.%20State-certified%20US,phone%20line%20%28HynoConnect%29%20for%202FA%20security%20verification.)
   * A functioning corporate website or app landing page that clearly displays your product, service description, pricing, and contact terms.[hynogo.com](https://hynogo.com/services/mercury-business#:~:text=*%204.%20Official%20US%20Registered%20Agent%20and,showing%20product%20descriptions%2C%20pricing%2C%20and%20contact%20terms.) (Mercury’s underwriting team strictly evaluates your web presence to verify active intent).
2. **Submit Online Application:** Go to Mercury and register as a non-U.S. resident business. During the KYC (Know Your Customer) video/biometric check, upload a scan of your passport. Because you have no SSN, Mercury will use your passport and foreign address for identity verification.

---

### Step 4: Apply for Apple Developer Organization Account
To launch apps under your company name rather than your personal name on the App Store, you need an organization account.

1. **Get a D-U-N-S Number (Crucial for Apple):** 
   * Apple requires a **D-U-N-S Number** (issued by Dun & Bradstreet) to verify that your Wyoming LLC is a legally registered entity.[www.ein.so](https://www.ein.so/blog/ein-for-mobile-app-developers/#:~:text=What%20Does%20the%20Apple%20Developer%20Program%20Require%3F,the%20mechanism%20for%20the%20first%20two%20checks.) 
   * Once your LLC is active in public records, you can request a D-U-N-S number for free through Apple’s enrollment pipeline or directly via the D&B web portal. It typically takes 1–2 weeks to register.
2. **Enroll in the Apple Developer Program:**
   * Register using an Apple ID configured with two-factor authentication.
   * Select **Organization** as your entity type.
   * Provide your Wyoming LLC details, EIN, and D-U-N-S number.[www.ein.so](https://www.ein.so/blog/ein-for-mobile-app-developers/#:~:text=Apple's%20verification%20for%20organizations%20is%20the%20strictest,apply%20for%20the%20EIN%20on%20Form%20SS-4.) 
   * Apple will perform a verification check (and occasionally call the primary contact number associated with your business to confirm authority).[www.ein.so](https://www.ein.so/blog/ein-for-mobile-app-developers/#:~:text=Apple's%20verification%20for%20organizations%20is%20the%20strictest,apply%20for%20the%20EIN%20on%20Form%20SS-4.)
   * Pay the annual **$99 USD** membership fee using a supported international credit card or virtual card linked to your bank account.

---

### Step 5: Apply for Google Play Console Organization Account
Google Play’s organizational verification process is generally more straightforward than Apple's.[www.ein.so](https://www.ein.so/blog/ein-for-mobile-app-developers/#:~:text=What%20Does%20Google%20Play%20Require%3F%20A%20one-time,same.%20An%20individual%20developer%20supplies%20an%20SSN.)

1. **Create a Google Play Developer Account:** Register for a developer account and pay the one-time **$25 USD** registration fee.
2. **Choose Organization Account:** Select organization/business type during profile setup.
3. **Submit Verification Documents:** Provide your legal business name, Wyoming address, and your **IRS EIN**. Google will verify your documents through business registry and tax ID compliance rather than forcing a D-U-N-S lookup.
4. **Tax & Payouts:** Complete the tax profile setup inside Google Play Console using your LLC’s EIN so that earnings can be paid out directly to your Mercury business bank account without foreign withholding penalties.[www.ein.so](https://www.ein.so/blog/ein-for-mobile-app-developers/#:~:text=Can%20a%20Non-US%20Developer%20Publish%20With%20a,payments%20are%20held.%20No%20SSN%20is%20needed.)

---

items.original_text:
Setting up a U.S. corporate structure (Wyoming LLC), opening a digital business bank account (Mercury), and applying for official Apple and Google organization developer accounts from China **without a U.S. Social Security Number (SSN)** is a well-established and entirely legal roadmap for international founders. Because you reside in China and do not have an SSN, you will use your **People's Republic of China (PRC) Passport** for identification.

The complete, sequential blueprint to execute this from start to finish is outlined below.

---

### Step 1: Form Your Wyoming LLC
You do not need to be a U.S. citizen, resident, or have an SSN to form a Wyoming LLC. 

1. **Appoint a Wyoming Registered Agent:** Wyoming law requires a registered agent with a physical street address in the state to accept legal mail. You can hire a reputable formation service (e.g., Northwest Registered Agent, Firstbase, or HynoGo) which will provide this agent and a physical mailing address.
2. **File Articles of Organization:** Submit the Articles of Organization to the Wyoming Secretary of State. The standard state filing fee is **$100**. This can be completed online within 24 hours.
3. **Draft an Operating Agreement:** Create an internal company document detailing that you are the 100% owner/manager of the LLC. Banks like Mercury and payment processors like Stripe will require this.

---

### Step 2: Obtain an EIN (Employer Identification Number) Without an SSN
Because you do not have an SSN, you **cannot** use the IRS online portal (which strictly requires an SSN/ITIN for the responsible party). Instead, you must apply via mail or fax.

1. **Fill out Form SS-4** (Application for Employer Identification Number).
   * On **Line 7b** (where an SSN/ITIN is normally requested), write **"Foreign"** or **"N/A"**.
2. **Submit via Fax:** Fax the completed and signed Form SS-4 to the IRS international fax line (**+1-855-215-1627**). *(Note: Many international founders use a specialized EIN filing agency or their registered agent service to handle this securely to avoid international long-distance friction).*
3. **Receive your CP 575 / Letter 147C:** The IRS will process the fax and return an official EIN confirmation letter (typically within 1 to 3 weeks).

---

### Step 3: Open a Mercury Bank Account
Mercury is a popular fintech banking partner that explicitly supports remote international founders who own U.S. LLCs.

1. **Prepare Your Documents:**
   * Certificate of Formation / Articles of Organization (Wyoming)
   * IRS EIN Confirmation Letter (CP 575 or 147C)
   * LLC Operating Agreement
   * Your valid **PRC Passport**
   * A functioning corporate website or app landing page that clearly displays your product, service description, pricing, and contact terms. (Mercury’s underwriting team strictly evaluates your web presence to verify active intent).
2. **Submit Online Application:** Go to Mercury and register as a non-U.S. resident business. During the KYC (Know Your Customer) video/biometric check, upload a scan of your passport. Because you have no SSN, Mercury will use your passport and foreign address for identity verification.

---

### Step 4: Apply for Apple Developer Organization Account
To launch apps under your company name rather than your personal name on the App Store, you need an organization account.

1. **Get a D-U-N-S Number (Crucial for Apple):** 
   * Apple requires a **D-U-N-S Number** (issued by Dun & Bradstreet) to verify that your Wyoming LLC is a legally registered entity. 
   * Once your LLC is active in public records, you can request a D-U-N-S number for free through Apple’s enrollment pipeline or directly via the D&B web portal. It typically takes 1–2 weeks to register.
2. **Enroll in the Apple Developer Program:**
   * Register using an Apple ID configured with two-factor authentication.
   * Select **Organization** as your entity type.
   * Provide your Wyoming LLC details, EIN, and D-U-N-S number. 
   * Apple will perform a verification check (and occasionally call the primary contact number associated with your business to confirm authority).
   * Pay the annual **$99 USD** membership fee using a supported international credit card or virtual card linked to your bank account.

---

### Step 5: Apply for Google Play Console Organization Account
Google Play’s organizational verification process is generally more straightforward than Apple's.

1. **Create a Google Play Developer Account:** Register for a developer account and pay the one-time **$25 USD** registration fee.
2. **Choose Organization Account:** Select organization/business type during profile setup.
3. **Submit Verification Documents:** Provide your legal business name, Wyoming address, and your **IRS EIN**. Google will verify your documents through business registry and tax ID compliance rather than forcing a D-U-N-S lookup.
4. **Tax & Payouts:** Complete the tax profile setup inside Google Play Console using your LLC’s EIN so that earnings can be paid out directly to your Mercury business bank account without foreign withholding penalties.

---
